question: Into what ultimate locus do all these wheels dissolve and merge?
premises: All those elements are merged in the bindu.
That merged totality is declared to be the Śrī Cakra.
inference: The Śrī Cakra is the supreme wheel in which all others dissolve within the bindu.
plain_english: All of that, merged in the bindu, is declared to be the Śrī Cakra.
